title: OversampleQA: a diagnostic toolkit to validate, audit, and benchmark oversampling methods
description:
OversampleQA is a Python toolkit for validating oversampling methods used in imbalanced classification. It implements hidden-majority validation: a portion of the majority class is hidden, and each synthetic minority sample is scored by its nearest-neighbour distance to the hidden majority and to the real minority. A synthetic sample that sits closer to the hidden majority counts as an error, so the resulting error rate measures how often an oversampler produces majority-like artifacts.

The package provides binary and multiclass validation, a broad set of distance metrics (Hassanat, Euclidean, Mahalanobis, Hellinger, Jensen-Shannon, Wasserstein, and others), memory-efficient distance matrix computation, benchmarking across datasets and oversamplers with exportable results, plotting and reporting helpers, a configurable command-line interface, and a plugin system for custom metrics and validators.

The validation methodology follows Hassanat et al., "Stop Oversampling for Class Imbalance Learning: A Critical Review" (2022).
